scenarios.name: the manager and editor expose the version 26 surfaces
the editor validates typed and relative dates before Apply
Add and the High value column save a compound lookahead filter
the saved filter and its result survive a full reload
Any selected filter highlights instead of removing rows
All Activities clears the filter and the highlight
criterion rows renumber when moved and deleted
the editor renders in a Persian RTL cell without overflow
list parameters use a typed picker and the saved choice reloads
Optimize removes duplicate and implied criteria without changing matches
Duplicate stores a second filter and keeps the original
Cut moves a saved filter to the clipboard and Paste restores it
Clear empties the filter definition without touching the applied filter
